question: _____, Chief Minister of Nagaland, hoisted the National Flag at the state level celebration of 76th Independence Day at Naga Civil Secretariat Plaza Kohima, on August 15, 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neiphiu Rio**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Neiphiu Rio** is the Chief Minister of Nagaland and has been serving in this role since March 2018.
 
• On **August 15, 2022**, Neiphiu Rio hoisted the National Flag at the state-level celebration of the 76th Independence Day at Naga Civil Secretariat Plaza, Kohima.
 
• Rio is a veteran politician from Nagaland and a member of the Nationalist Democratic Progressive Party (**NDPP**).
 
• This Independence Day celebration marked the occasion of **Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav**, commemorating 75 years of India’s independence.
 
• Neiphiu Rio emphasized the importance of peace, development, and unity in his Independence Day speech during the event.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav**: A government initiative launched to celebrate and honor 75 years of India’s independence, focusing on achievements, history, and heritage.
 
• **Nagaland:** Nagaland became the 16th state of India on December 1, 1963, and its capital is Kohima.
 
• **Neiphiu Rio's Leadership:** Under his leadership, Nagaland has focused on infrastructure development, peace talks, and resolving longstanding issues related to the insurgency.
 
• **National Flag Hoisting:** Hoisting the National Flag on Independence Day is a mark of respect and patriotism, symbolizing India's sovereignty and unity.
 
• **Naga Civil Secretariat Plaza:** This is a prominent venue in Kohima where significant state-level celebrations and government functions are held.
